cards.text: Jesus has breathed His last, and the crowd has gone home. Now Luke brings in a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, from the Judean town of Arimathea. Luke calls him a good and righteous man.

cards.question: Joseph sits on the Council. True or false: Joseph went along with the Council's decision about Jesus.
Luke says Joseph, the good and righteous Council member, was waiting for the ___ of God.

cards.text: Then Joseph walks right up to Pilate, the governor. I bet that took nerve, friend. I used to flinch every time somebody opened my junk drawer, and this man goes to see the GOVERNOR.

cards.question: Joseph of Arimathea goes to Pilate. What does he ask Pilate for?

cards.text: Then Joseph takes the body of Jesus down and wraps it in a linen cloth.

cards.question: Joseph has wrapped the body of Jesus in linen. Where does he lay it?

answers.text: In a tomb cut into the rock
In the field of the potter

cards.question: True or false: other people had already been laid in the rock tomb where Joseph places Jesus.

cards.text: It's Preparation Day, and the Sabbath is beginning. Preparation Day. Friend, in my bakery that's EVERY day. I've got flour in places a stamper shouldn't have places.

cards.question: Joseph isn't the only one at the tomb. Who follows and sees how the body of Jesus was placed?

cards.text: So the women head home and prepare spices and perfumes. Spices AND perfumes. These women came ready. Me? I show up to work with a mustache and a smile, and only one of those is useful.

cards.question: The women from Galilee have their spices and perfumes ready. Then the Sabbath comes. What do they do on the Sabbath?

answers.text: They rest as the commandment says
They go back to the tomb

cards.text: Then comes the first day of the week. Very early in the morning, the women head to the tomb with the spices they prepared. Very early. Before-the-first-snooze-button early.

cards.question: When the women reach the tomb with their spices, what do they find?
The women step inside the tomb. True or false: they find the body of the Lord Jesus there.

cards.text: They're standing there puzzling over it. Then suddenly two men in radiant apparel are right beside them. Friend, when light came into my drawer, I jumped so high I nearly left my gold base. And I CAN'T leave my gold base.

cards.question: Two men in radiant apparel suddenly stand beside the women in the tomb. What do the women do?

answers.text: They bow their faces to the ground
They drop the spices and cry out
They reach out to touch the men

cards.text: Then the two men ask them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?”

cards.question: The two men at the tomb tell the women not to look for the living among the dead. What do they say about Jesus?

cards.text: Then they tell the women to remember what Jesus told them back when He was still in Galilee.

cards.question: Back in Galilee, Jesus had said the Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified, and on the ___ day rise again.

cards.text: And then they remember His words. They head back from the tomb, and news like this does NOT stay in your apron pocket.

cards.question: Back from the tomb, the women report all these things to the ___ and to all the others.

cards.text: Luke names some of the women who told the apostles: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them.

cards.question: The women tell the apostles everything that happened at the tomb. True or false: the apostles believe them right away.

cards.text: Nope. Their words seemed like nonsense to the apostles, and they did not believe the women. You ever walk into the break room with the best news of your LIFE and get a wall of raised eyebrows? Trust me, I know eyebrows. Those were RAISED.

cards.question: Peter, one of the apostles, hears the women's report too. What does he do?
At the tomb, Peter bends down to look in. All he sees are the ___ cloths.

cards.text: So Peter goes away, wondering to himself what had happened. I bet he replayed it the whole walk back. Stick with me, friend. This story is FAR from done.

findings.problem: The card states facts from the previous passage: Jesus breathed His last (Luke 23:46) and the crowd went home (Luke 23:48). It gives no reference for them, and the card's citation is only Luke 23:50-51.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences. Only the opening card can have more than 2.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has 4 sentences: 'It's Preparation Day...', 'Preparation Day.', 'Friend, in my bakery...' and 'I've got flour...'.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has 5 sentences: 'So the women...', 'Spices AND perfumes.', 'These women came ready.', 'Me?' and 'I show up to work...'.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'The Eleven apostles' teaches the baker that the apostles are called 'the Eleven'. That gives away the answer to Stop 2 Card 11, where 'Eleven' is the right word in the blank.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences. Only the opening card of the walkthrough can have up to 3.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The joke puts Papa Dorin on his gold base while he was in the drawer. The backstory says the gold base first appeared when he was renewed in the Dorinverse ('When the light faded, Papa Dorin was standing on a gold base'), so this adds something new to his story.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The question says the two men 'tell the women not to look for the living among the dead.' In Luke 24:5 they ask a question: 'Why do you look for the living among the dead?' The question turns their question into a command.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: Mary Magdalene and Joanna appear here for the first time, but the card only names them and never says simply who they are (for example, from Luke 8:2-3).

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Stop 1 Card 6 ('wraps it in a linen cloth') and the Stop 1 Card 7 question ('wrapped the body of Jesus in linen') both say the cloth was linen before this card asks the baker to fill in 'linen'. Linen was told on those cards, not answered on an earlier choice card, so this card's answer is given away.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: This story card has 4 sentences, counting the line that says the story isn't over.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
